A.claim: Consolidated necessary conditions on any Beal counterexample, kernel-verified: the bases are pairwise coprime; A != B; the exponents are not all divisible by 3; x and y are not both divisible by 4 with z even; and neither 3 nor 4 divides gcd(x,y,z). Together with exponent reduction: if a counterexample exists, one exists with all exponents in {4} u
